_meta.description: Headline facts about Mumbai Metro Line 5 (Thane-Bhiwandi-Kalyan). Each fact carries its own source and status. Figures follow MMRDA's press release of 28 May 2026 (PRC/PR/31/2026) on the expanded corridor. Names follow the owner's decision (2026-10-09): Phase 1 Kapurbawdi to Dhamankar Naka, Phase 2 Dhamankar Naka to Durgadi, Phase 3 Durgadi to Kalyan, and Line 5A the spur from Bhoirwadi to Ulhasnagar. MMRDA calls Phase 3 and the spur together 'Phase 5A'. MMRDA's Line 5 page still shows the 2017 plan, kept as history.

status_values.verified: Confirmed by a primary source (MMRDA website or an MMRDA-published document).
status_values.reported: From a reputable secondary source (news or trade press). Not confirmed by a primary source.
status_values.unverified: Single weak source, or could not be confirmed. Show with a warning in the UI.
status_values.conflicting: Sources disagree. The value is the most recent credible figure; see 'alternatives'.

line_color.notes: MMRDA's Line 5 page names no colour. MMRDA's Line 12 page calls Line 12 the Orange Line, and Wikipedia treats Lines 5 and 12 as one Orange Line.

route.value: Thane (Kapurbawdi) to Kalyan, via Bhiwandi and Durgadi, with a spur from Bhoirwadi to Ulhasnagar

history.value: Thane to Kalyan APMC, via Bhiwandi
history.context: 2017 plan, still on MMRDA's Line 5 page

length_km.context: Phase 1 11.9 km + Phase 2 10.48 km + Phase 5A 11.83 km. Phase 5A covers Durgadi to Kalyan and the spur to Ulhasnagar, so this total includes the spur.

history.context: Line 5 before Phase 5A was added, Kapurbawdi to Durgadi (MMRDA press release, May 2026)
2017 plan, Thane to Kalyan APMC, fully elevated (still on MMRDA's Line 5 page)

length_km.notes: MMRDA does not give the spur's length on its own. A post on X (31 Aug 2026) gives 5.27 km for the spur and 11.82 km for Durgadi to Kalyan, which together exceed MMRDA's 11.83 km; MMRDA's figures are used. The centre line drawn from MMRDA's 2025 alignment file is 21.9 km from Kapurbawdi to Durgadi Fort.

phases.stations_note: Balkum, Kasheli, Kalher, Purna, Anjurphata and Dhamankar Naka. Kapurbawdi is built as part of Metro Line 4, and is the interchange with it.

alternatives.context: Viaduct length in MMRDA's Phase 1 environmental report (Sep 2023)
Length of civil contract CA-28, Kapurbawdi to Dhamankar Naka
Stretch whose overhead wires were energised from 7 Sep 2026
MMRDA statement reported in February 2026, with 7 stations counting Kapurbawdi

phases.notes: 11.9 km in MMRDA's press release (May 2026); 11.88 km in its environmental report. The other figures probably measure different ends (the contract and the wires run past the last station), but no source says so.

phases.stations_note: Bhiwandi (underground), Temghar, Rajnoli, Gove Gaon, Kon Gaon and Kongaon West: 1 underground and 5 elevated.
phases.notes: Approved by the Union Government on 29 Aug 2026 (reported). Not started. Its route follows MMRDA's 2025 alignment file, which runs along the road medians of Agra Road through Bhiwandi, the Bhiwandi bypass and Kalyan-Bhiwandi Road to the Ulhas river bridge at Durgadi, except where it goes underground at Bhiwandi.

phases.stations_note: Durgadi, Khadakpada, Bhoirwadi, Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Path, Shanti Nagar, Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Chowk and Ulhasnagar, all elevated, including the spur. MMRDA does not say which are on the spur.
phases.notes: MMRDA calls this section and the spur together 'Phase 5A: Durgadi - Khadakpada - Bhoirwadi - Kalyan with Spur to Ulhasnagar', 11.83 km. The line splits at Bhoirwadi: one arm to Kalyan and the Line 12 interchange, one to Ulhasnagar (Construction World, Mar 2026). A post on X (31 Aug 2026) gives 11.82 km for Durgadi to Kalyan alone. Not started; route not published.

stations_count.context: Phase 1: 6, Phase 2: 6, Phase 5A (Phase 3 and the spur): 7. Kapurbawdi, the Line 4 interchange, is not counted.

history.context: 2017 plan, Balkum Naka to Kalyan APMC (still on MMRDA's Line 5 page)
Station points in MMRDA's 2025 alignment file, counting Kapurbawdi

completion_cost_crore_inr.label: Estimated cost of the expanded corridor, Phases 1, 2 and 5A
completion_cost_crore_inr.context: Phase 1 Rs 6,741 crore, Phase 2 Rs 7,326 crore, Phase 5A (Phase 3 and the spur) Rs 4,063 crore.

history.context: 2017 plan, 24.9 km, including land and taxes (MMRDA's Line 5 page; the March 2016 project report)

completion_cost_crore_inr.notes: The 2017 figure broke down as civil Rs 3,212.34 crore, systems Rs 2,946.56 crore, taxes, design charges, Rs 146.93 crore of land and Rs 20 crore of interest during construction (MMRDA environmental report, Sep 2023).

funding.value: AIIB and OPEC Fund loans for the systems; MMRDA funds the rest
funding.notes: AIIB approved a concept for a USD 236 million loan on 21 Apr 2020, for rolling stock, signalling, telecom, fare collection, power and depot machinery, within a USD 436 million systems cost: AIIB 54%, OPEC Fund (then OFID) 23%, MMRDA 23%. MMRDA's Phase 1 environmental report (Sep 2023) confirms that AIIB funds Phase 1 (verified). The final loan amounts were not found on AIIB's or MMRDA's sites.

details_reported.layout: 30 stabling lines, a 3-line workshop, a 4-line inspection shed and a 690 m test track

history.context: Earlier options. Both lie on Phase 2, so Kasheli was chosen for Phase 1 (MMRDA environmental report, Sep 2023).

value.connects_to: Metro Line 12 (Kalyan-Taloja) and the Central Railway at Kalyan Junction

interchanges.notes: MMRDA's press release (May 2026) names Line 4 at Balkhum (Kapurbawadi) and Line 12 at Kalyan Junction, and direct access to the suburban stations at Thane, Kalyan, Vitthalwadi and Ulhasnagar.

daily_ridership_2031.notes: Peak-hour peak-direction traffic 26,143. MMRDA's Marathi page says 3.023 lakh and the Phase 1 environmental report 3.03 lakh.

travel_time_benefit.value: Reduces travel time by 40% to 50% compared with the road

alternatives.value: Reduces current travel time by 50% to 75%

current_phase.value: Phase 1 built and preparing for the CMRS safety inspection; overhead wires energised from 7 Sep 2026. Phase 2 and Phase 5A approved, not started.
current_phase.notes: MMRDA's press release (28 May 2026) says Phase 1 is preparing for the CMRS inspection. The report quotes MMRDA: inspection for 15 to 20 days after energisation, then about six months of trial runs. Work beyond Bhiwandi, towards Kalyan, has not begun.

progress.notes: MMRDA's table does not say which stretch it covers. Its items (station spines and wings) match the Phase 1 design, and work beyond Bhiwandi has not begun, so it describes Phase 1. MMRDA's Marathi Line 5 page shows a Line 7A table here instead (checked 9 Oct 2026).

target_completion.notes: MMRDA's press release (28 May 2026) quotes the Chief Minister: Phase 1 will open by the end of 2026. A news report of September 2026 says trial runs take about six months, which does not fit. No exact date.

rest_of_line.context: Phases 2 and 3 towards Kalyan, and the Line 5A spur to Ulhasnagar

underground_section.value: Bhiwandi station, the only underground station

alternatives.value: Dhamankar Naka to Temghar, added in a 2025 review
A short stretch near Bhiwandi, to avoid the Bhiwandi bypass flyover

underground_section.notes: MMRDA names the station but not the length of the tunnel. MMRDA's 2025 alignment file runs on the Bhiwandi bypass flyover for about 2.6 km between Bhiwandi and Temghar, the clash the underground stretch avoids.

technical.notes: Phase 1 design values from MMRDA's environmental report (Sep 2023): two-level stations over the road median, with side platforms.

rolling_stock.scope: Rolling stock, CBTC signalling and train control, telecom, platform screen doors, and depot machinery at Kasheli
rolling_stock.notes: The same contract is in Line 12's rollingstock.json (line5_contract). Award date not pinned down: reports range from mid to late 2025.

related_projects.name: Metro Line 5A (Bhoirwadi to Ulhasnagar spur)
related_projects.summary: Spur from Bhoirwadi, on Line 5's Phase 3, to Ulhasnagar. MMRDA counts it in 'Phase 5A' with Durgadi to Kalyan: 11.83 km, 7 stations and Rs 4,063 crore together.
related_projects.notes: MMRDA gives no length for the spur alone; a post on X (31 Aug 2026) gives 5.27 km. Unlike Line 12A, it is inside MMRDA's 34.21 km total for Line 5, so the length and cost totals include it.
